in_sanskrit.name: मिर्तुन्जय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विजय: victory, मृत्: death, न्: negation, ज: conquer. So, Mirtunjay means 'conqueror of death' or 'victor over death'

in_hindi.name: मिर्तुन्जय
in_hindi.long_meaning: मृतु: मृत् (death), नजर: नजरा (conqueror). So, Mirtunjay in Hindi means 'conqueror of death'.

in_tamil.name: மிர்துந்ஜய்
in_tamil.long_meaning: மிர்: மீட் (death), துந்: துன்மால் (conquer), ஜய்: ஜீர் (victory). So, Mirtunjay in Tamil means 'victor over death'.

in_telugu.name: మిర్థున్జై
in_telugu.long_meaning: మిర్: మీదే (death), థు: థూళు (conquer), జై: జీర్జనే (victory). So, Mirtunjay in Telugu means 'victor over death'.

in_marathi.name: Mirtunjay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory over death
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mirtunjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mirtunjay is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Mrit' (death) and 'Anjay' (victory). This name is believed to symbolize the victory of life over death.
